title: [review] test_vectors.py: Self-referential fallback causes asserti
description: The assertion `assert h == o.get("hash_32", o.get("expected_hash", h))` uses the computed value `h` as the final fallback default. If neither `hash_32` nor `expected_hash` exists in the output dict, the assertion becomes `h == h`, which always passes. This means missing expected values in vector files do not cause test failures.
